itemcasino.stats.title: Casino stats
itemcasino.info.vault:
Every loss at the tables feeds one shared pot. Choose the share of it you are playing for, put your offering in the slot, press Draw.
Win and that share is yours; lose and the offering is gone. A draw is always worth %1$s %% of the offering, so a smaller share buys better odds — never past %2$s %% though.
%3$s %% of the offering joins the pot. Drag the slider, scroll it, or hold − and +.
itemcasino.reject.share_too_small: That share of the pot rounds down to no whole item.
itemcasino.jackpot.announce_share: %s has taken %s%% of the casino jackpot, worth %s chips!
itemcasino.tooltip.mine_field: Chips only. Turn tiles over and cash out before you find a mine. Returns 97 %.
itemcasino.info.mine_field:
Chips only. Pick how many mines, press Start, then turn tiles over: every safe tile raises what a cash-out pays, a mine takes the stake.
Cash out when you like; leaving the table does it for you. More mines pay in bigger steps on shorter boards. %2$s %% of everything staked comes back on average, a %1$s %% house edge.
Scroll or hold − and + to set the mines.
itemcasino.tooltip.dice: Chips only. Pick a chance and a side of the line. Returns 97 % on average.
itemcasino.label.dice_hint: Drag the line, pick a side, roll
itemcasino.info.dice:
Chips only. Set the line, pick Under or Over, then Roll: the server rolls 0.00 to 99.99 and you win if it lands on your side.
The rarer the call, the more it pays — any chance from %3$s %% to %4$s %%, with a long shot capping how much you may stake. %2$s %% of everything staked comes back on average, a %1$s %% house edge.
Drag the line, scroll over it, or hold − and +.
itemcasino.card.bearer: The chips belong to whoever holds the card
itemcasino.info.cashier:
Put gold, iron, copper, diamonds or emeralds in the lower slot and press Deposit — ingots, nuggets and blocks all count. They become chips on your Chip Card, at the value the tables use.
Pick a currency and a count and press Withdraw to buy items back, at their value plus %s %%.
The card is bearer: whoever holds it owns the chips. Shift over any item shows its value.
itemcasino.reject.chips_only: This table plays chips only: get a Chip Card at the Cashier.

itemcasino.bet.caption: Bet
itemcasino.info.slots:
Put items (up to %1$s in one pull) or a Chip Card in the slot, then pull the lever.
Three alike pays the multiplier on the paytable. Two alike pays as well, from %2$s up — smaller pairs pay nothing.
Over many pulls %3$s %% of everything put in comes back.
itemcasino.hint.chip_card_slot: Chips only: put a Chip Card here. The Cashier gives you one for your diamonds, emeralds, gold, iron or copper.
itemcasino.hint.cashier_card_slot: Your Chip Card goes here. No card yet? Put currency in the slot below and press Deposit: one is made for you.
itemcasino.reject.cashier_currency: The Cashier only takes diamonds, emeralds, gold, iron and copper. Play other items at the tables.
itemcasino.reject.game_disabled: This game is switched off on this server.
itemcasino.tooltip.cashier: Changes currencies into chips at their full value, and back for a small fee.
itemcasino.tooltip.pocket: A private table in your pocket. Closing it settles the game and hands everything back.
itemcasino.info.upgrader:
Put a stack or a Chip Card in the slot, press Target… to choose the item you want, then Spin.
Gold under the pointer: the target is yours. Anything else: the stake is gone.
Your chance is what you staked against what you asked for, minus a 10 %% house edge, so 90 %% of a stake comes back on average. Longer than 1 in 1000 is refused.
itemcasino.info.blackjack:
Put your stake in the slot and press Deal. Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over.
Hit takes a card, Stand ends your turn. Double doubles the stake for exactly one more card; Surrender gives half of it back.
A win pays x2, 21 in two cards pays x2.5, a tie returns the stake. The dealer draws to 16 and stands on 17.
itemcasino.info.coin_flip:
Two chairs, one coin. Each player puts a stake of about the same worth in their own slot and presses Ready; the winner takes both.
The house takes nothing: each chair wins as often as its stake is large, and the percentage under each stake says how often.
itemcasino.tooltip.game_core: The works of a casino machine. Every table is built around one.
